side.name: Being heard
side.line: The people in charge don't listen to people like me.

side.name: Local control
side.line: Decisions about my town get made by people far away.

why.detail: Someone ignored by their own city council and someone whose town is run from the state capital name different problems and would each pick one easily. Not being heard is about my voice being ignored by any official; local control is about where decisions get made, even by people who might listen.

current.name: Being heard
current.line: The people in charge don't listen to people like me.

proposed.name: Local control
proposed.line: Decisions about my town get made by people far away.

side.name: Freedoms
side.line: I'm losing the freedom to make my own choices.

side.name: Institutions
side.line: I see the institutions we rely on falling apart.

why.detail: People who feel personally restricted and people worried about the system as a whole often aren't the same people, so both need a place to say it. Freedoms is my own choices being taken away; democracy slipping is the shared system of courts, elections and press weakening.

current.name: Freedoms
current.line: I'm losing the freedom to make my own choices.

proposed.name: Institutions
proposed.line: I see the institutions we rely on falling apart.

side.name: Money in politics
side.line: I see the rules bend for people with money.

why.detail: A broken campaign promise and a rich donor getting special treatment are different complaints, and the lines already say which is which. Accountability is leaders breaking promises and facing nothing; corruption is the rules bending for people with money.

why.detail: Someone can trust the news and still not know which candidate fits them, so the two pains name different moments. Voting is about the choice in front of me at election time; misinformation is not trusting what I read about anything.
